title: Speed tests
intro: The speed tests attendees ran from their seat's help page, side by side per switch: a switch that is slow for every seat on it is the switch or its uplink, not the seats.
since: Each seat's latest test of the last {{hours}} hours.
none: No speed tests in the last {{hours}} hours. Attendees run them from the help page behind their seat's QR code.
slowHint: Slow: under half the hall's median download, with at least 2 seats tested.
noSwitches: No tested seat has a known switch yet: the port reads haven't found them.
